Jal Nigam, Jharkhand
Office of the Executive Engineer · Jharkhand · IN
No. CC/7/2018/115
Dated: March 31, 2026
Certificate of Completion of Work
This is to certify that the work of “Cable Stayed Bridge — Jharkhand Pkg-115” (large bridges),
awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has
been completed in all respects on February 23, 2018 at a gross executed value of INR 81,44,00,000/-
(Rupees 81.44 Crore Only).
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on
satisfactory completion of the final inspection.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Asha Nair. This certificate is issued for record and
for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
Executive Engineer
Jal Nigam, Jharkhand
